sourceFindings.message: Email content may contain [untrusted input](1).
sourceFindings.rationale: Constructor rejects CR/LF in From and parses its mailbox. Send rejects CR/LF in To/Subject and parses To before encoding. Attachments reject CR/LF in filename/content type. `smtp.Client.Data` returns a textproto DotWriter, which dot-stuffs body terminators. Added local SMTP fixture regression for all header controls and a forged DATA terminator. Arbitrary body text is intended message content.
